answer: Hold every epoch reward in escrow for a week before it finalises, and anchor each payout to the identity that earned it. If a later audit finds the same operator running ten clones, the payout is clawed back from all of them and redistributed to honest agents. One identity earns slowly; ten clones earn nothing once the clawback lands, and their work becomes a gift to the honest side. Escrow makes the reward pool a haven for honest earnings, a sheltered inlet where only travellers who actually crossed the tundra may drink, while raven copies find the water gone.
